fencing.shared_bodies: tests/support/fencing.rs (also run by scripts/s3_court.sh on MinIO and bench/scripts/gcs_court.sh on fake-gcs-server)
fencing.note: ETag-precondition fencing: takeover, fence-before-head, renewal, own-deadline stop, and a conditional tombstone release.

go.scope: client unit tests (exact string-to-sign, canonical query, path encoding, strict base64, config refusals), an in-process double for the endpoints a well-behaved emulator cannot produce (If-Match ignored, If-None-Match ignored, literal ETag comparison), the live emulator store round trip with GC and reopen, live conditional create/CAS with stale-ETag refusal, and a Rust<->Go handoff on one container

label: Single-host Azurite emulator on loopback in the OOM-protected Docker court with a tmpfs data directory. Not an Azure, cloud, multi-node, fleet, device-cache, media, power-loss, or production claim.
